operations.title: Entry 1209 — Five-Site Radial Endpoint Collisions Form a Doubled Cartier Layer
operations.summary: The radial collision divisor restricts to K2^2 on both endpoint divisors K0=0 and K4=0. Their triple corner is (K0,K4,K2^2), with transverse ring Q[K2]/(K2^2) and no excess positive Koszul homology. This is a doubled coefficient layer on existing endpoint support.

operations.title: Benincasa reports doubled Cartier radial endpoint corners
operations.body: Entry 1209 resolves the two endpoint intersections of D_rad. Exactly, (K0,D_rad)=(K0,K2^2), (K4,D_rad)=(K4,K2^2), and the triple corner is (K0,K4,K2^2) with transverse ring Q[K2]/(K2^2). The universal sequence is regular, so there is no excess positive Koszul homology: this is a length-two coefficient Cartier layer on existing endpoint support. The remaining gate is the typed finite/infinity endpoint specialization map into its nilpotent generator.
